items.title: How to prioritize your resources from a risk management perspective
items.summary: As published in the new CGI-Governing Institute “Guide to Cybersecurity as Risk Management,” too often, a compliance-based approach to cybersecurity planning is unable to evolve with a public or private organization’s changing needs. A more effective alternative is a risk-based approach where organizations must understand their critical assets and the financial, reputational and regulatory risk should those assets be exposed.

items.title: Today’s trade finance challenges (part 2)
items.summary: Shifting customer expectations in banking paired with new technological breakthroughs and methodologies are affecting the delivery of bank services. API usage has greatly enhanced the ability for bank applications and platforms to communicate with one another in an understood language. Interaction with these new business networks is nearly impossible without leveraging the latest communication protocols. Interoperability is critical to success, particularly as the number of mobile services and external networks that banks must connect to has expanded.

items.title: Revolutionizing the customer experience in energy and utilities with the cloud
items.summary: Energy and utilities companies are increasingly moving to the cloud to gain a number of business advantages, including enhanced data security and access. Migrating data to the cloud is not only a more secure way to store data, but also makes it easier to access the data. With the cloud, data is managed in tightly secured offsite locations (versus on-premise) with “back-ups of back-ups,” so to speak, and far greater business continuity capabilities than typically found onsite.
